Patient: 2 years, A 2-year-old boy presents with diarrhea for 3 days, poor oral intake, and lethargy.

TRIAGE LEVEL: 🔴 EMERGENCY
Life-threatening. Refer to hospital IMMEDIATELY.

SUSPECTED CONDITIONS:
  • Severe Dehydration (95% confidence)
  • Very Severe Disease (90% confidence)

RECOMMENDED ACTIONS:
  1. Begin fluid management for severe dehydration (Plan C) immediately if trained, or give sips of ORS if the child can drink while arranging transport.
  2. Refer URGENTLY to the nearest hospital.
  3. Keep the child warm and prevent low blood sugar during transport.
  4. Advise the mother to continue offering breastmilk or ORS on the way to the hospital if the child is able to swallow.
